kpi_rationale: Locked from Q2 2026 shareholder letter's own 'Summary of Financial and Key Operating Metrics' table plus the DAU emphasis in mgmt commentary ('single most important KPI' per Apr-2026 preview). DAU/MAU = user growth engine management is explicitly prioritizing over near-term monetization. Paid Subscribers = conversion of that growth into payers. Total Bookings = forward-looking cash economics (leads revenue due to ratable recognition). Revenue = GAAP top line. Adj. EBITDA Margin = whether user-growth investment is compressing profitability as guided.
